summary: Chapter 3 delivers both scheduled beats and all listed payoffs and promises through scenes that genuinely turn and that earn a real, ironic purpose, but it asserts a handful of exit-state changes and one character's presence without grounding them in any scene's action.

issues.fix_hint: Give kalt_witwe one concrete action in s2's intent (e.g. she points Stettler to a specific drawer or box, or asks him a question he deflects) so her presence does something beyond being searched around.
No scene shows or references the burial happening; add a short clause to s2's intent noting the funeral already took place before the Nachlass is ordered.
The claim that the flu wave recedes and the village never learns of the confession is not shown in any scene; fold one observational line into s3 noting the quieting practice as the thaw sets in.

The pass opening is the chapter's title premise but is only presupposed before s1 begins, never dramatized; add a brief opening beat to s1 (e.g. word arrives the road is clear) so the triggering event is earned on the page.
